name: icusync
description: Connect Claude to your intervals.icu training data. Pull and push workouts, analyse training history, and manage your calendar conversationally.

ICUSYNC_USER_TOKEN.title: IcuSync User Token
ICUSYNC_USER_TOKEN.description: Your IcuSync API token from your dashboard at icusync.icu

tools.name: get_athlete_profile
tools.description: Retrieve athlete profile and training zones

tools.name: get_training_history
tools.description: Retrieve recent training activities and fitness data

tools.name: get_activity_detail
tools.description: Retrieve detailed lap-by-lap data for a specific activity

tools.name: get_events
tools.description: Retrieve planned calendar events from the athlete's intervals.icu calendar

tools.name: get_fitness
tools.description: Retrieve CTL, ATL and TSB fitness metrics across a date range

tools.name: push_workout
tools.description: Push planned workouts to your intervals.icu calendar

tools.name: edit_workout
tools.description: Edit an existing workout on your calendar

tools.name: delete_workout
tools.description: Delete a workout from your calendar

tools.name: get_wellness
tools.description: Retrieve wellness data including HRV, sleep, resting heart rate and other daily wellness metrics

tools.name: push_wellness
tools.description: Write wellness data to intervals.icu: nutrition totals (kcal/macros), subjective scores (fatigue, soreness, mood, motivation, stress), weight, and daily notes

tools.name: get_best_efforts
tools.description: Retrieve best effort times and paces for key distances (400m, 1km, 5km, 10km, half marathon, marathon) from the pace curve

tools.name: get_power_curves
tools.description: Get the athlete's best power output curve for a given time period and sport (Ride or Run)

tools.name: get_climb_segments
tools.description: Detect sustained climb segments in an activity and compute VAM (vertical ascent rate) for each

tools.name: get_extended_metrics
tools.description: Retrieve advanced sensor metrics for a specific activity including running dynamics, core temperature, DFA alpha1, W' balance and blood glucose

tools.name: get_training_summary
tools.description: Aggregate training stats over a date range including total volume, TSS, calories by sport, zone distribution and week-by-week breakdown

tools.name: update_activity
tools.description: Update a completed activity in intervals.icu: name, description, feel, perceived exertion, carbs ingested, gear, tags, and custom activity fields

tools.name: update_sport_settings
tools.description: Update an athlete's threshold values (FTP, threshold pace, LTHR, max HR, W') in intervals.icu for Run, Ride, or Swim
